measured_facts_retained.interpretation: Shared-r64 explains too little of this Qwen3.8 artifact to establish a useful representation win. GPU reconstruction and complete-token effects were not measured.

adjudication: The 3,781,882,584-byte headline is exactly the lossy binary residual sum, not the HQ30UQ4 residual selected by the committed harness as the admissible reconstruction-preserving store.
The HQ30UQ4 residual is exactly as large as the original Q4 tensors; adding the generator increases storage by 726,151,136 bytes.
The claimed 1.125 residual BPW, 9.315 GB traffic cut, 4.307 GB moved total, and net-reduction=true are invalid for shared-r64 plus HQ30UQ4.
No artifact, decode hook, protected capability run, GPU reconstruction time, or complete-token A/B exists; this mechanism is not a candidate.
